guidance.bestFor: Bold, italic and underline as 3 separate icon only toggles in the default variant, with bold pressed on load
agentNotes: Bold starts on through `defaultPressed` and no toggle applies any formatting; wire each one to your editor commands

whenNotToUse.when: Bold, italic and underline kept as one set whose pressed values are read together

guidance.bestFor: Outline toggles that pair an icon with a text label, Italic and Bold, both off on load
Text only outline toggles at the sm, default and lg sizes side by side, labelled Small, Default and Large

whenNotToUse.when: Comparing the 3 sizes on icon only controls with a caption beside each

guidance.bestFor: An outline Button set beside an outline toggle in 2 rows, a text pair at sm and a bold icon pair, to compare them
agentNotes: The icon only `Button` in the second row has no `aria-label`; add one or screen readers announce it unnamed

guidance.bestFor: Text only toggles locked by the disabled prop in both variants, default and outline, with no enabled control beside them

whenNotToUse.when: Enabled and disabled controls set side by side for comparison

guidance.bestFor: A single outline bookmark toggle with an icon and a fixed Bookmark label, left uncontrolled

whenNotToUse.when: A save control whose icon and label change once it is pressed

guidance.bestFor: A bell in the default variant with a destructive count badge on its top right corner that hides while pressed
agentNotes: The count is a fixed 3 inside `Badge`, shown only while `pressed` is false; feed it your unread total

guidance.bestFor: An icon only star toggle repeated at sm, default and lg, each row captioned in muted text

whenNotToUse.when: Comparing the 3 sizes on controls that carry a text label

name: c-toggle-9
title: Toggle with icon swap on press
label: Icon Swap
description: Toggle with icon swap on press

guidance.bestFor: An icon only heart in the default variant that gains a solid fill while pressed, with no label or count

whenNotToUse.when: A reaction that also shows a running count beside the heart

name: c-toggle-10
title: Toggle with text label that changes
label: Label Swap
description: Toggle with text label that changes

guidance.bestFor: An outline bookmark that fills in and relabels itself from Bookmark to Bookmarked once pressed

whenNotToUse.when: A bookmark whose label stays the same in both states

guidance.bestFor: Like, retweet, share and bookmark outline toggles in a row, each count rising by 1 while pressed
agentNotes: Counts are hardcoded literals switched by `liked`, `retweeted`, `shared` and `bookmarked`; load the real totals from your data

guidance.bestFor: An icon only outline pin whose purpose, Pin to sidebar, appears in a tooltip on hover
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` takes the `Toggle` through `render` on the base twin; the radix twin uses `asChild` inside a `TooltipProvider`

guidance.bestFor: Formatting icons in 4 toggles, bold and italic enabled, underline and strikethrough disabled, each pair default then outline

whenNotToUse.when: Just the disabled look, shown on text labelled controls in both variants

guidance.bestFor: A large outline speaker that swaps to a muted speaker icon and from Sound to Muted while pressed
agentNotes: `muted` drives only the icon and label; apply it to your audio or video element from `onPressedChange`
